description: Umferð is a dataset listed in Icelandic geoportal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by National Land Survey of Iceland. Reiknuð umferð á þjóðvegakerfinu, frá árinu 2008. Umferðartölurnar eru reiknaðar fyrir einstaka hluta vegakerfisins á stofn-, tengi- og landsvegum og fylgja miðlínugrind Vegagerðarinnar. Eldri umferðartölur sem ná aftur til ársins 1975 eru eingöngu til á töfluformi og eru ekki tiltæk í landupplýsingakerfi sem stendur. Útreikningarnir byggja á tvenns konar talningu, þ.e. árstalningu og skynditalningu. Coverage: IS. Its keywords include ársdagsumferð, SDU, Vegagerðin, þjóðvegir, sumardagsumferð, umferð. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-is.
